definitions.explanation: Antisocial or illegal behavior, especially by young people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧{非行|ひこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Juvenile delinquency has become a social problem.

examples.japanese: {非行|ひこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: More young people are turning to delinquency.

examples.japanese: {非行|ひこう}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んで→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They are working on delinquency prevention activities.
examples.notes: {非行|ひこう}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ = delinquency prevention

examples.japanese: {非行|ひこう}⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更生|こうせい}させる→更生：18057_kousei⟧⟦ための→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.english: It is said that the home environment is one of the causes of delinquency.

notes:
Commonly used to refer to juvenile crime and antisocial behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧{非行|ひこう} (juvenile delinquency)
- {非行|ひこう}⟦{少年|しょうねん}→少年：03238_shounen⟧ (juvenile delinquent)
- {非行|ひこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to turn to delinquency)
- {非行|ひこう}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (delinquency prevention)
- {非行|ひこう}⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧ (delinquent group)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧ - flight, flying (aircraft)

USAGE:
The character {非|ひ} means "not" or "wrong," and {行|こう} means "conduct," so {非行|ひこう} literally means "wrong conduct."
